question: Has Aceitera Peninsular Española been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Aceitera Peninsular Española now?
markdown:
Aceitera Peninsular Española S.L. (APE)
has not been acquired or merged with another company
. It remains an independent, family-run business based in Priego de Córdoba, Spain, and is still owned and operated by the same family through five generations of tradition in the olive and vegetable oil industry.
Aceitera Peninsular Española
Company Status
Independence:
Operating as a private, closely held family enterprise.
Location:
Headquartered in Priego de Córdoba, Spain (the center of high-quality extra virgin olive oil production).
Leadership:
Retains its historic family-run management structure across five generations.
